mentions.name: First-principles MTG deck builder
mentions.description: A program that builds Magic: The Gathering decks from first principles of card data, deliberately avoiding reliance on user-posted deck aggregations or EDHREC and using no AI. It exposes a slew of internal tuning knobs for deck generation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a program to build Magic: The Gathering decks from first principles of card data, no reliance on user-posted deck aggregation or EDHREC, and no AI. A slew of internal knobs exposed.
